# Project coding instructions

- Always generate backend code in Java.
- Prefer enterprise Java patterns and frameworks such as Spring Boot when appropriate for the task.
- Only use AngularJS for frontend code when it is absolutely necessary for the project or existing architecture.
- Avoid introducing AngularJS for new frontends unless the requirement explicitly calls for it.
- Keep backend and frontend responsibilities clear: Java for APIs, services, data access, and business logic; frontend code only when needed and minimized.
- When a frontend is required, prefer the simplest viable solution unless the project already depends on AngularJS.
- Do not generate backend logic in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, or other languages unless the user explicitly requests it.
